max_num_limits_per_side.meaning: maximum number of unique price levels allowed per order book side

tree_size.meaning: number of unique price levels currently in the order book side red-black tree

worst_level_order_count.meaning: number of orders resting at the worst price level

assumptions: The attacker can post better-priced orders repeatedly (as_attacker_can_post).
The worst price level already holds more than one order before the new order is posted.
The order book side is at maxNumLimitsPerSide unique price levels before the new order is posted.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether the attacker's two tiny orders are placed before or after the book side is full, so the exact ordering of the two tiny orders relative to the full-side condition is not fixed.
Report does not specify the exact number of orders already at the worst price level in a real scenario; only that it is more than one.

limitations: Only the direct impact i_tree_size_exceeds_max is formalized; i_unbounded_growth and i_dos_funds are deferred to future claims.
The attacker's two tiny orders precondition (p_attacker_two_tiny_orders) is not selected as a P term because its temporal relation to the full-side condition is ambiguous.
The assumption as_attacker_can_post is contextual and not encoded as a P term.
Code-level binding of maxNumLimitsPerSide and tree_size to concrete storage variables is deferred.
